response.rationale: Both answers express the same three-month period. Indonesian kuartal is valid and synonymous with triwulan; Malaysian Malay suku tahun is the ordinary equivalent. The differing forms support different-common-word, with no false-friend issue. Triwulan is an additional Indonesian synonym, not a learner-critical error.
